disorder-name.detail: Parkinson's disease patients from the PPP (Personalized Parkinson Project) dataset. NM built from ABRIM healthy cohort was applied to PPP cohort (both healthy controls and PD patients) for validation.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "the utility of the normative trajectories in a validation dataset consisting of both healthy participants and people with Parkinson's disease"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Personalized Parkinson Project (PPP) data collection (Bloem et al., 2019). 316 patients used after visual data curation.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "an independent cohort with a similar imaging protocol, which is part of the 'Personalized Parkinson Project' (PPP) data collection (Bloem et al., 2019)"

age.detail: Age from Table 2 (PPP Patient group). Min/max not reported.

sex.detail: N (Male; Female) = 316 (175; 141). Percentages calculated from counts: 175/316=55.4%, 141/316=44.6%.
